objective: Complete the Oasis Baklawa Appverse. PR completion is subordinate to application completion.

status_vocabulary.CLEARED: Completed and verified against every mandatory gate for the stated scope.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed until a named dependency or blocker clears.
status_vocabulary.READY: Prerequisites are clear and work may start.
status_vocabulary.NOT_CLEARED: Known remaining work or clearance evidence is incomplete.
status_vocabulary.LOCKED: Deliberately cannot begin until upstream programme gates clear.

clearance_rule: A merged PR is evidence only. It MUST NOT automatically set a stage or substage to CLEARED. CLEARED requires every mandatory gate declared for that item.

critical_path.current_primary_blocker: No single universal blocker. App completion currently converges through migration/schema governance, WhatsApp certification, 3PGS closure, and pre-factory commercial/payment authority.
